QUOTE: Neither the library nor its own sample programs contain a spawn site inside `library/`, so the library never creates its own threads. ... `library/threading.c` is wrapped entirely in `#if MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that no threads are created in library/, but it frames library/ as providing mutex locks that protect internal library state rather than as the mutex abstraction that threaded callers use. Because the contrast is not made, the item is not shown.
